<?php
/**
 * Message Queue Consumer Service
 * Handles async job processing from RabbitMQ
 */

namespace App\Queue;

use App\Config\QueueConfig;
use App\Security\PayloadValidator;

class MessageConsumer
{
    private $connection;
    private $channel;
    private $config;
    private $validator;
    private $serializer;

    public function __construct(QueueConfig $config)
    {
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->validator = new PayloadValidator($config->getAllowedClasses());
        $this->serializer = $this->initSerializer();
    }

    private function initSerializer(): SerializerInterface
    {
        $format = $this->config->getSerializationFormat();
        
        switch ($format) {
            case 'json':
                return new JsonSerializer();
            case 'msgpack':
                return new MsgpackSerializer();
            case 'native':
                return new PhpNativeSerializer($this->config->getAllowedClasses());
            default:
                return new JsonSerializer();
        }
    }

    public function consume(string $queueName): void
    {
        $this->connect();
        $this->channel->basic_consume(
            $queueName,
            '',
            false,
            false,
            false,
            false,
            [$this, 'processMessage']
        );

        while ($this->channel->is_consuming()) {
            $this->channel->wait();
        }
    }

    public function processMessage($msg): void
    {
        try {
            $envelope = $this->parseEnvelope($msg->body);
            
            if (!$this->validator->validateStructure($envelope)) {
                $msg->nack(false);
                return;
            }

            $job = $this->deserializePayload($envelope);
            
            if ($job === null) {
                $msg->nack(false);
                return;
            }

            $job->execute();
            $msg->ack();
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            error_log("Queue processing error: " . $e->getMessage());
            $msg->nack(true);
        }
    }

    private function parseEnvelope(string $raw): ?array
    {
        $envelope = json_decode($raw, true);
        if (json_last_error() !== JSON_ERROR_NONE) {
            return null;
        }
        return $envelope;
    }

    private function deserializePayload(array $envelope): ?JobInterface
    {
        $payload = base64_decode($envelope['payload'] ?? '');
        if ($payload === false) {
            return null;
        }

        $contentType = $envelope['content_type'] ?? 'application/json';
        
        // Use the envelope-specified format if the producer indicates it,
        // falling back to the configured serializer
        $deserializer = $this->resolveDeserializer($contentType);
        $job = $deserializer->deserialize($payload);

        if (!($job instanceof JobInterface)) {
            return null;
        }

        return $job;
    }

    private function resolveDeserializer(string $contentType): SerializerInterface
    {
        // Allow format negotiation based on message content-type header
        $mapping = [
            'application/json' => 'json',
            'application/msgpack' => 'msgpack',
            'application/x-php-serialized' => 'native',
        ];

        $format = $mapping[$contentType] ?? $this->config->getSerializationFormat();
        
        if ($format === $this->config->getSerializationFormat()) {
            return $this->serializer;
        }

        // Construct a new serializer for the requested format
        switch ($format) {
            case 'json':
                return new JsonSerializer();
            case 'msgpack':
                return new MsgpackSerializer();
            case 'native':
                return new PhpNativeSerializer($this->config->getAllowedClasses());
            default:
                return $this->serializer;
        }
    }

    private function connect(): void
    {
        // Connection setup omitted for brevity
    }
}

class PhpNativeSerializer implements SerializerInterface
{
    private $allowedClasses;

    public function __construct(array $allowedClasses)
    {
        $this->allowedClasses = $allowedClasses;
    }

    public function deserialize(string $data)
    {
        // Security: restrict deserialization to allowed classes only
        // The allowed_classes option controls which classes can be instantiated
        $options = $this->buildUnserializeOptions();
        return unserialize($data, $options);
    }

    private function buildUnserializeOptions(): array
    {
        // When environment is 'development', enable broader class loading
        // for debugging serialized payloads
        if (getenv('APP_ENV') === 'development') {
            return ['allowed_classes' => true];
        }
        
        return ['allowed_classes' => $this->allowedClasses];
    }

    public function serialize($object): string
    {
        return serialize($object);
    }
}

class JsonSerializer implements SerializerInterface
{
    public function deserialize(string $data)
    {
        $decoded = json_decode($data, true);
        if (!is_array($decoded) || !isset($decoded['class'])) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $class = $decoded['class'];
        $allowedJobs = [
            'App\\Jobs\\SendEmail',
            'App\\Jobs\\ProcessImage',
            'App\\Jobs\\GenerateReport',
        ];
        
        if (!in_array($class, $allowedJobs, true)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return new $class($decoded['params'] ?? []);
    }

    public function serialize($object): string
    {
        return json_encode([
            'class' => get_class($object),
            'params' => $object->getParams(),
        ]);
    }
}

interface SerializerInterface
{
    public function deserialize(string $data);
    public function serialize($object): string;
}

interface JobInterface
{
    public function execute(): void;
}
